title: Manifestations of Xenophobia in AI Systems
benchmark_measurement: The paper cites benchmarks that measure persistent anti-Muslim bias, the association of Muslims with violence, and varying degrees of positive or negative sentiment across religious groups in large language models.
findings: The paper reports findings from other studies indicating that large language models exhibit persistent anti-Muslim bias and associate Muslims with violence. This is used as an example of harmful societal stereotypes that can be inherited and amplified by foundation models, intersecting with the paper's main focus on xenophobia.
